summary: Progress gains an `xs` size — the 6px track the Image Upload sheet draws inside a file row. Additive: md and sm are unchanged. It exists so that row does not hand-roll a track, because a hand-drawn bar has no role=progressbar, no aria-valuenow, and no reason to reach for --ui-bg-accent-legible — the upload sheet fills its own track with --ui-bg-accent, 1.24:1 against the well in light. Reusing Progress makes that failure unrepeatable rather than merely discouraged.

migration.manual: Additive — no existing size changed. `size="xs"` is available on Progress.
